name: smwmusic-the-lost-vikings-amiga-ingame
title: The Lost Vikings (Amiga) - Ingame 4 (Factory)
description:
The factory song from The Lost Vikings on the amiga. I know that there APPEARS to already be a port of this song by Sinc-X, but the song he ported was actually the Candyland theme. That should be changed.
I think its more fitting for grasslands, but you could use it on a factory too I guess.
